near-miss distractor facts (same entity type, different entity) are planted so retrieval requires matching the exact entity

code.carried_over_from: 003-context-quality (models, runtime, server flags, lengths, task types, generation settings, scoring rules, harness)
haystack_requirements: at least ~600 KB of source so 128K tokens is reachable without repeating files
the same repo and file order for every length (64K is a prefix of 128K is acceptable)
no vendored/generated/minified files, no tests-only padding
planting_rules: planted code must be syntactically valid (ast.parse every modified file) and match the repo's style
all planted identifiers and values are random (no shared tokens or digits with question keys)
single_retrieval: a module-level constant with a random string value; ask for its value
multi_retrieval: four functions registered with a planted decorator or registry call, spread across files; ask for the four function names
aggregation: a planted helper function with 2-8 call sites spread across files, plus near-miss decoy helpers with similar names; ask how many call sites
multi_hop: three-step chain across different files: function A calls function B; B reads constant C; ask for C's value starting from A
near-miss decoys for every task (similar identifier, different value)
single_retrieval balanced 5/5/5 early/middle/late per length; others spread 5-95%
answer_format_rules: prompts state the exact JSON shape and item type, e.g. {"answers": ["name1","name2","name3","name4"]} where each item is a string
content scoring as in 003 is primary; exact-format score kept as a secondary column
